newsitem.title: INDIA: Indonesia sees 1997 growth at over seven pct.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia sees 1997 growth at over seven pct.

text.p: Indonesia expects economic growth to exceed seven percent this year, after reporting 7.5 percent growth in 1996, Indonesia's Coordinating Minister for Production and Distribution Hartarto said on Friday.
Hartarto told a business conference in the Indian capital that Indonesia reported gross domestic product (GDP) growth of 7.5 percent in 1994, 8.5 percent in 1995, and 7.5 percent in 1996.
"This year we expect more than seven percent," he said without elaborating.
